mood.VERY_LOW: I know today feels heavy. Be gentle with yourself — a small break is part of progress too. I'm here with you.
mood.SERIOUS_DISTRESS: You do not have to carry this alone. Contact someone you trust now; if you may hurt yourself, call your local emergency number or go to the nearest emergency department.
mood.LOW: Hard days happen. Just take one small step today and leave the rest for tomorrow. I'm here.
mood.OKAY: You're doing fine. Accept today as it is and do what you can — that's enough.
mood.GOOD: Your energy is up, great! Carry this motivation into today's plan — you'll get a lot done.
mood.GREAT: So glad you feel amazing! Use this momentum to give yourself a strong push today.

motivation.START: Take one small step today — that's enough. I'm here with you.
motivation.GOING: Your consistency is going great. Let's keep it up today — I'm with you.

START_TASK.title: Start with {taskTitle}
START_TASK.message: This is today's one small step. Let's begin when you are ready.
START_TASK.lowMoodMessage: Focus only on this small step today. Keeping it short is okay.

ADD_TASK.title: Add one task for today
ADD_TASK.message: Choose one small, realistic task; a single step is enough.

DAY_COMPLETE.title: Today's plan is complete
DAY_COMPLETE.message: That is enough for today. Notice your effort and rest.

official.EXAM_DATE: You can see the official exam date in the verified card.
official.APPLICATION: For application information, I only share verified Knowledge Hub sources.
official.RESULT_PLACEMENT: For result and placement information, I only share verified sources.
official.PROCESS: For official processes, I only share verified Knowledge Hub sources.
official.UNAVAILABLE: No verified card or source is currently available for this topic. You can check the Knowledge Hub.

ghost.NEW_RECORD: New record! You beat your best net so far. You've officially left your past self behind.
ghost.BEAT_PREVIOUS: You beat your last attempt — past-you is defeated. The momentum is with you.
ghost.TIED: You're level with your last attempt. Consistency is a win too; one small step puts you ahead.
ghost.BELOW_PREVIOUS: A little behind this time — it happens. Don't dwell on one attempt; look at your trend. I'm here.

focus.PHOTO_SIGNAL: {subject} appears most often in your wrong-answer photos. Let's add it to your next plan.
focus.LOWEST_AVERAGE: A small review of {subject} could be a good next step.
focus.PHOTO_SIGNAL_EARLY: {subject} appeared in your first wrong-answer photo signal. We can treat it as a small starting step.
focus.PHOTO_SIGNAL_REPEATED: {subject} keeps appearing in your wrong-answer photos. Let's add it to your next plan.
focus.LOWEST_AVERAGE_EARLY: {subject} needs a little more support in your first mock exam. A short review is a good start.
focus.LOWEST_AVERAGE_REPEATED: {subject} keeps appearing as an area to strengthen. A short review is a good next step.
focus.TREND_FIRST: Your first recent signal for {subject} is here. One more mock exam will make the direction clearer.
focus.TREND_UP: {subject} is moving upward in your recent attempts. A short review can help keep that rhythm.
focus.TREND_DOWN: {subject} needed a little more support in your latest attempt. One short review is enough without overreading one result.
focus.TREND_STEADY: {subject} stayed steady across your latest two attempts. A short review may create the next opening.
focus.PHOTO_TOPIC_REPEATED: {topic} within {subject} keeps appearing in your wrong-answer photos. A short topic review is a good next step.

weekly.INSUFFICIENT: One mock exam or two completed sessions is enough to review last week.
weekly.RHYTHM: You focused for {minutes} minutes across {sessions} sessions and {days} days.
weekly.RHYTHM_LOW: Even with low energy, you showed up for {sessions} sessions and {minutes} focused minutes.
weekly.RHYTHM_MIXED: Your energy varied, yet you completed {sessions} sessions and {minutes} focused minutes.
weekly.RHYTHM_STEADY: Your energy was steady across {sessions} sessions and {minutes} focused minutes.
weekly.PERFORMANCE_EARLY: This week's first signal is {net} net. The direction will become clearer with another week.
weekly.PERFORMANCE_COMPARABLE: Your weekly average is {net} net, a {delta} change from the previous week.
weekly.FOCUS_REPEATED_PHOTO_SIGNAL: {subject} keeps appearing in your wrong-answer photos. A short review is a good next step.
weekly.FOCUS_WEEKLY_DECLINE: {subject} needs the most support compared with last week. One short review is enough to start.
weekly.FOCUS_LOWEST_NORMALIZED: {subject} stands out as this week's focus after question-count normalization.
weekly.FOCUS_SESSION_RHYTHM: Let's keep the rhythm with two small focus sessions this week.
